summary: Page geometry matches the official 2018 PDF well, but Page 2 numeric columns are left-aligned, Part V Schedule 1 seller/buyer/corp/base print blank, and screen Item 4 truncates the TIN branch code while Item 11 omits the 11B IPO label.

defects.where: Page 2, Part IV, Part V (Schedules 1-3), and Part VI numeric columns
defects.what: Amount Involved, Number of Shares, Tax Base, Tax Rate, Tax Due, and Total values all print left-aligned instead of right-aligned.

defects.where: Page 2, Part V Schedule 1 (Seller, Buyer, Issuing Corporation, Number of Shares, Tax Base)
defects.what: Schedule 1 rows 1-4 print Dates (06/15/2026) but Seller, Buyer, Issuing Corporation, Number of Shares, and Tax Base print blank/0.00 despite being filled.

defects.where: Page 1, Items 7 (Registered Address), 7A (ZIP Code), 9 (Email), and 10A (Tax Relief Specify)
defects.what: Address, Email, and 10A Specify collide with comb ticks; Email prints lowercase; Item 7A ZIP Code prints blank.
The 5-digit branch code (00000) is truncated with ellipsis (000...) in the read-only TIN box.
Segmented options show "11A Shares of Stocks Listed and Traded through the LSE | Primary | Secondary" without the "11B Initial Public Offering" label for Primary/Secondary.

defects.cause: before.db draft had transaction_month=0, transaction_day=0, transaction_year=2026, and Form2552Draft::to_bir_field_map formatted 0 as "00" -> "00002026".
defects.fix: Added Form2552Draft::to_print_field_map() in crates/bir-core/src/forms/form_2552.rs (leaving upload to_bir_field_map untouched) to emit empty string for unset 0 month/day/year parts, with unit test print_field_map_blanks_unset_item_1_date_parts.

shared_changes_wanted.issue: 2552 Part I Item 4 TIN branch code truncates '00000' to '000...'
shared_changes_wanted.proposed_one_line_change: return fs.map((f, i) => (i === fs.length - 1 && (f.m === 5 || (fs.length === 4 && f.m == null)) ? 1.4 : 1));
shared_changes_wanted.note: Left nsh/screens/form/schema.ts untouched per orchestrator instruction; data half ('m': 5) added in forms/schema-overrides.json.

shared_changes_wanted.issue: 2552 Part V Schedule 1 Seller/Buyer/Corp/NumShares/TaxBase not persisted from screen form fill into draft.schedule
shared_changes_wanted.note: writer-cells.json joins and form_2552.rs field_map are intact; screen draft binding drops non-Date Schedule 1 columns.

tests_run: Live app capture via just nsh-run-agent linux (verified Part III plain notes on screen-04 and 2552 print pages)
open_questions: Note: print-p*.png pages were generated from the running app Print preview sheet.html via headless Chrome + pdftoppm.

blank_item_causes.Part V Schedule 1 columns (Seller, Buyer: Not a missing join or wrong cell id: html-frozen/2552-2018/writer-cells.json already joins all 40 Schedule 1 cells (p2c22..p2c75), and crates/bir-core/src/forms/form_2552.rs emits them cleanly when draft.schedule is populated (pinned by field_map_uses_official_formats). In the live app, form.fill persisted Date on rows 1-4 but left Seller/Buyer/Corp/NumShares/TaxBase empty in the saved draft (screen_form_module.rs draft-mapping gap).

fixed_in_this_commit: Replaced all 4 developer-facing Part III notes (Items 26-29) in forms/schema-overrides.json with plain taxpayer wording (no file paths or jargon).
Added data half '"m": 5' for frm2552:txtPg1TIN4 in the 2552 block of forms/schema-overrides.json (checked 1800, 1801, 1600WP, 1602Q: all four already have m: 5 on their TIN branch boxes).
remaining_shared_issues: Page 2 numeric columns left-aligned: fixed on try/forms-shared-print (commit 0f484378; before/after already verified on 2552 p2).
Growable schedule rows beyond 5: documented in form-review/SHARED-FINDINGS.md on try/forms-shared-print (commit 1679ff23).

fixture_replay.mechanism: Canonical BEFORE SQLite database (/home/ubuntu/BuwizNsh/agents/before.db) is cloned verbatim to after-deterministic.db and each form draft is also exported to /home/ubuntu/BuwizNsh/agents/fixtures/<FORM>.json. replay_fixtures.py opens the exact saved draft via the Filings UI (nav-filings -> return-<id>, never form.open which resets open-ended O1 drafts), clicks fp-print, and asserts length(data_json) is identical before and after printing.

review_followups.item_1_date: Fixed in crates/bir-core/src/forms/form_2552.rs::to_print_field_map() (prints blank MM/DD instead of 0000 when unset; prints 06/15/2026 when set).
review_followups.number_of_shares_alignment: Fixed in shared print commit 058a0e9b on try/forms-shared-print (right-aligns plain numeric quantity columns including 2552 Schedules 1-3 col (e) and Part VI Number of Shares, plus 1800/1801/1706/1606 Area and Shares).
review_followups.item_11b_screen_label: Fixed in forms/schema-overrides.json (2552 block) by changing the colon to an en-dash ("11B Initial Public Offering – Primary" / "11B Initial Public Offering – Secondary") so nsh/screens/form/schema.ts:191 choiceLabel does not strip the "11B Initial Public Offering" prefix; verified in after/screen-02-part-i-background-information.png.
